JPEG, PNG or WebP: choose the format for the job

Use JPEG for a photograph when broad compatibility matters and transparency is unnecessary. Use PNG when lossless edges or transparency matter more than size. Try WebP when the destination accepts it and you can compare the actual result. There is no single smallest format for every image.

How to fix invalid JSON without changing the data
Developer
How to fix invalid JSON without changing the data

Fix syntax before formatting. JSON needs double-quoted keys and strings, correctly paired brackets and commas only between entries. Once it parses, check whether the values still mean what you intended: valid syntax does not guarantee a correct data model.

By Tool Fera
